briefdescription.para: AvailableQueue - The priority queue to use for the available SUnits.
PendingQueue - This contains all of the instructions whose operands have been issued, but their results are not ready yet (due to the latency of the operation).

detaileddescription.para: Once the operands become available, the instruction is added to the AvailableQueue.

briefdescription.para: HazardRec - The hazard recognizer to use.
Schedule - Schedule the DAG using list scheduling.
releaseSucc - Decrement the NumPredsLeft count of a successor.

detaileddescription.para: Add it to the PendingQueue if the count reaches zero. Also update its cycle bound.

briefdescription.para: scheduleNodeTopDown - Add the node to the schedule.

detaileddescription.para: Decrement the pending count of its successors. If a successor pending count is zero, add it to the Available queue.

briefdescription.para: listScheduleTopDown - The main loop of list scheduling for top-down schedulers.
ScheduleDAGVLIW - The actual DFA list scheduler implementation.
